snippet.title: Collector's Cove Demo Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2025
snippet.description: DEMO: Collector's Cove is a farming game where you sail the seas to uncover fabled crops and fish. Explore diverse islands and customize your boat and animal companion, all while you grow your collection. Play the demo now on Steam! https://s.team/a/2867470 #WholesomeDirect #SummerGameFest #IndieGames
